| corp-ops | (none) | — | — |
| corp-pdf-toolkit | `/CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md` | Yes | Move to `docs/` |
| corp-sca-time-automation | `/CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md` | Yes | Move to `docs/` |
| ai-council | `/CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md` | Yes | Move to `docs/` |

### Recommended approach

**Per-repo `docs/CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md`** is the best option:
- Keeps review close to the code it covers
- Standard convention (`docs/` is idiomatic)
- No cross-repo coupling
- Existing `docs/` dirs: corp-by-os (empty), corp-rfp-agent (has `ARCHITECTURE_LESSONS_LEARNED.md`)

Centralized `.ecosystem/reports/code-reviews/` is worse because reviews reference repo-specific code and should travel with the repo.
